## Description {#details}

<p>BTF_KIND_FUNC_PROTO are followed by multiple "struct BTFParam".</p>


<p>The exist number of <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/btf/btfparam">BTFParam</a> is stored in the vlen (of the info in "struct CommonType").</p>
